sections.title: Concluding Remarks
sections.extract: The spectral theory of Riemann surfaces has been a popular and fruitful ﬁeld of study for many years, and is still an active area of research. The main body of this work documented the investigation of the Laplace spectra of two speciﬁc surfaces: the Bolza surface and the Klein quartic.
